reddit.title: Introducing New Movement Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share our latest devtalk on the new movement mechanics in Provincia! We've revamped how formations work, ensuring that soldiers turn and march realistically without any teleportation. Check out the details on how drag facing and attack turns have been improved to enhance your gameplay experience. Learn more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
